name: Fishers Island Club
location: Fishers Island, Town of Southold, Suffolk County, New York
architects: Seth Raynor (1925-26), completed by Charles Banks; opened 1926

dtm.source: bare earth from the ground points (class 2) of the 2014 USGS CMGP Lidar: Post Sandy (Long Island, NY) (NOAA Data Access Viewer dataset 4938, job J1476275), gridded to 1 m in EPSG:32619 by pipeline/intake.py dtm (mean per cell, gaps filled linearly from their rim); NAVD88 m

laz.source: 2014 USGS CMGP Lidar: Post Sandy (Long Island, NY) (NOAA Data Access Viewer dataset 4938, job J1476275), flown 7 April 2014 (GPS times), leaf-off; no vegetation classes (trees from class 1); NAD83(2011) / Connecticut (EPSG:6433, m), NAVD88 m; GitHub release assorted-lidar-data, fishers.zip, clipped to the world with pipeline/intake.py laz
laz.label: 2014 USGS post-Sandy lidar, leaf-off

ortho.source: New York State orthoimagery, 'Latest' service (orthos-np.its.ny.gov wms/Latest), exported by the developer 2026-10-25 as two JPEGs at 0.5 m in EPSG:26919 (release assorted-lidar-data: 12345.jpg west, 1234.jpg east), placed by their request boxes and mosaicked by pipeline/intake.py ortho; white corners are outside the state's coverage; flight year not stated

world.note: OSM course boundary (way 191740591) bbox 1,577 x 1,435 m in UTM 19N + ~120 m scenery, whole 256 m chunks, centred: 2,048 m east-west (235 m each side), 1,792 m north-south (178 m each side); inside the 2014 lidar's footprint

scorecard_source: OpenGolfAPI (courses.opengolfapi.org/courses/ny/fishers-island-golf-country-club), read 2026-10-24 by the scouting chat: pars (72; 8 and 18 par 5), stroke index and one unlabelled per-hole row adding to 6,503, taken as Blue (the only rated tee: Blue 6,544, 71.8/143). Column 'back' is The Fried Egg's list (6,636, par 70 with 8 and 18 as par 4s; not built). Unverified; no club card online (private). Played from the tips, Black 6,597 yd (developer, 2026-10-25: "for all of these courses lets play from the tips"); rating Stymie (stymie.golf, USGA ratings), Black 6,597 yd 72.8/144. The other sets are in scorecard.csv but not built.
attribution: Elevation and trees: U.S. Geological Survey (2014 CMGP Post Sandy Long Island lidar), via NOAA Digital Coast
notes: Course chat, 2026-10-25: standing defaults (every penalty area red, OSM boundary as OB, trees from lidar). Played from the tips: Black (developer, 2026-10-25: "for all of these courses lets play from the tips"). Wind 3-14 mph (open coast: an exposed island). Bare earth from the lidar's ground points: the release has no DEM. Par 72 as on the card listings (the scouting's recommendation). Theme fishers_island: the course's own, from the developer's photos (developer: a new theme for each course).
red_water_note: the sea (proposed/sea.geojson, from OSM's coastline) and the ponds inside the boundary mapped as natural=water (by 16/17, by 5 and by 15): red penalty areas (standing default: every penalty area red)
rough_band_note: a mown band of rough along the fairways, then the tawny fescue (brief: rough_band_m ~2-3; the photos)

drop_trees.reason: course chat 2026-10-25: a 48 m 'tree' with a 1.6 m crown in the middle of the inlet hole 14 plays across (open water on the NYS photo): a stray class-1 lidar return, not a tree
